> Please note that Messenger templates configured using this feature an be used only with Messaging API v1 at the moment.

## Configuring Messenger Templates



![Screenshot of Messenger Template Configuration](https://files.readme.io/b3fc715-Messenger1.png)




To configure a new Messenger template:

1. Go to **Tools** > **Templates**.
2. Click **Add New Template**.
3. Enter a **Name** for the template. Only lower case letters and underscores are allowed in this field. Do not use spaces in the template name.
4. Select the **Channel** as **Messenger**.
5. Select one of the following options for **Notification Type**:
   1. **Select_Push**
   2. **No_Push**
6. In the **Message** field, add a message that should be displayed on the user’s device.
7. In the **Notification Type** drop-down, select one of the following:
   1. **Update**
   2. **Message Tag**
8. In the **Tags** drop-down, select one of the following options:
   1. **Account_Update**
   2. **Non_Promotional_Subscription**
   3. **Confirmed_Event_Update**
   4. **Post_Purchase_Update**
   5. **Human_Agent**
9. Enter the detail for **Expiry In Seconds** field.
10. Select **Lock this template to prevent other users to make changes** if you want the template to remain inaccessible for other users to make changes.
11. Click **Save**. The template is created.
